title: Warning not to disturb the earth

tellings.quote: don't when you disturb the earth, negative things happen.

plain: Around 2016, Brandon Fugal, the owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property known for reports of strange events, says he got a warning: "when you disturb the earth, negative things happen." He tells Michels he was told this by someone else and passes it on. It matters because it suggests that digging on the ranch might bring on whatever is happening there.
